subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue stay as the canonical umbrella while focused session-lock and subagent-delivery fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for completion isolation?
rationale: The remaining failures span bug fixes and product semantics around session ownership, active-run wake behavior, fallback lanes, and whether parent sessions should receive full child outputs or only handles.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540, and close it only after the linked root-cause slices are resolved or intentionally split.

options.title: Promote Completion Isolation
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and map the remaining reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Select one canonical issue per root cause, link the production evidence there, and close this umbrella only after that routing is explicit.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused items such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540, and close it only after the linked root-cause slices are resolved or intentionally split.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows direct ownership of subagent cancellation, registry, detached-task, and delivery-adjacent behavior, which makes this the best available routing candidate from the evidence.
